messages:
taylor: Kicking off the 04:00 UTC deploy window for API, runtime, console, and router. Staged traffic shift, runtime pin, console schema flip, then router header split. Quick thumbs from owners? @miguel @priyanka @arjun @lena :eyes:

miguel: I can take runtime. Plan is to pin runtime image runtime:v2.3.1 -> warmup GPU pool -> cutover. Will monitor kv cache pressure, latency.

priyanka: API ready. Will hold feature flags for new routing keys behind ff_ff_router_v2. Doing canary at 1%.

arjun: Console change is JUST UI schema; backend contract is stable. I'll push minor migration with feature flag off, enable after runtime pinned.

lena: Router header split tested in staging. I want to run a small mirror (5%) during runtime warmup to validate header route table. If no errors after 10m, ramp.

sam: SRE ack. I'll watch 5xx, p95 latency, and token CPU on the router hosts. Rollback triggers I want: 1) 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m, 2) p95 increase > 300ms, 3) cache eviction rate > 2x baseline.

deploybot: Deploy queued by taylor for 1739998888. Window: 04:00-05:00 UTC. Steps: runtime pin -> warm pool -> api canary -> console flag -> router mirror -> ramp.

miguel: Runtime pin command (one-liner):

```
./infractl pin --service runtime --image runtime:v2.3.1 --reason "staged deploy 04:00 UTC"
```

miguel: After pin I'll run `infractl warm --pool runtime-gpu --duration 8m` and report.

priyanka: API canary config (k8s patch):

```
- weight: 1
  service: api
  variant: api-v2
```

priyanka: Will keep canary at 1% for 10m, health-checks every 15s.

arjun: Console migration note: toggle remains off until runtime green. Migration is idempotent. If we need to abort, I can push rollback + disable flag in <2m.

lena: Router mirror plan: mirror-5pct -> validate headers not dropped, and response codes parity. If mirror shows >0.1% mismatch in 10m — hold.

sam: I'll create a quick dashboard link and alert: `ops.sentry/prod/deploys/1739998888` — alerting on the rollback triggers. If triggered, we'll do staged rollback starting with router -> console flag off -> api canary revert -> runtime unpin.

miguel: runtime warmup done (8m). KV cache steady, no OOMs, p95 +40ms. Proceeding to pin.

deploybot: runtime pinned to runtime:v2.3.1 by miguel at 1739998950.

priyanka: API canary at 1% for 10m now. No errors in first 3m.

lena: Router mirror started (5%) at 1739998975. First validation checks OK.

sam: Monitoring green so far (3m). No 5xx spike. p95 within +50ms.

arjun: Enabling console flag now — keeping off for 2m smoke then enable to 100% if ok.

priyanka: Canary bumped to 10% after 10m smoke. No anomalies.

lena: Mirror parity 0.02% mismatches over 12m, acceptable. Proceeding to ramp.

deploybot: Router ramping to 50% at 1739999005 per plan.

sam: All alerts quiet. Rolling forward to 100% over next 10m, but watch token CPU. If token CPU > 85% for 5m, we pause and rollback.

miguel: Noted. After full ramp I'll unpin v2.2 variants from the warm pools.

arjun: Console fully enabled at 1739999015. No regressions reported.

priyanka: API at 100% shortly, undoing canary.

taylor: Thanks team. Post-deploy checklist: update release notes with pinned runtime image and router header change, attach postmortem link if any alerts hit. Closing window at 05:00 UTC unless we see issues. :tada:
